source_quality_handling: Original Exclude qualifiers retained as separate groups, flagged as such; not pooled into unflagged evidence. Basic parser eligibility is not author approval of every raw record.
scope: Modern regional calendars and source CRU summary climate are not ancient cultivars, exact point observations, held-out Earth climate calibration, or a full date/yield validation. No parameter tuning, adoption, F use or population update. Duration envelope coverage is a necessary timing check, not a predicted-date or yield score. Cold exposure flags missing process representation; its percentage is not an exact model rejection rate. Location records and multiple seasons can be correlated; no confidence intervals calculated.
